## Definition

*What AVQI is, in one or two sentences.* The Acoustic Voice Quality Index is a
multivariate index combining several acoustic measures into a single estimate of
overall voice quality [@maryn2010avqi].

## Computation

*The component measures, how they are weighted, sustained-vowel vs. continuous
speech input, software versions (AVQI-3, etc.).*

## What it captures

*The construct — overall dysphonia severity — and how it relates to
auditory-perceptual ratings.*

## Confounds and cautions

*Recording quality, sample type, language, microphone effects.*

## Normative data

*Cutoffs, age and sex effects, reported thresholds.*
